title: The farmer and his ox
body: A farmer lives in a village where people use the barter system. He needs a pair of new shoes, a sweater and medicines for his grandmother, but all he can spare is one ox. First he must find someone who wants an ox. Since a pair of shoes is worth far less than an ox, he exchanges the ox for several bags of wheat instead. He then carries the wheat to different places: one person gives him shoes for part of the wheat, another a sweater, and a third the medicines. Each time, the two sides argue over how much wheat is a fair amount. The leftover wheat has to be stored safely, but it may rot or be eaten by rats, and the next time he needs something he has to carry the heavy bags with him again.
